title: A novel copper-based nanosystem for augmented breast cancer photothermal and chemodynamic therapy
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2167-2178
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08100A, Paper

Mohammad Seyedhamzeh, Farzaneh Falahi, Ali Kalantari-Hesari, Kimia Esmaeilzadeh, Laleh Salarilak, Hadi Bagheri, Shayesteh Bochani, Satar Yousefiasl, Helia Behrouzfar, Mohammad Esmaeil Akbari, Aziz Maleki
This work develops and characterizes copper-cysteine nanoparticles as a multifunctional nanoplatform combining photothermal therapy and chemodynamic therapy to ablates primary tumors and inhibit metastatic breast cancer cells in tumor-bearing mice.
